summary: AI/ML engineer (M.Sc. Computer Science, Machine Intelligence, 2026) with hands-on experience building computer-vision systems for drone and surveillance video, and production LLM applications in Python. At Quantumweave Intelligence, I develop detection, tracking, and intrusion-analytics pipelines with GPU inference, and surveillance dashboards. Experienced in agentic workflows, RAG systems, document extraction, and federated graph learning. Strong in Python and PyTorch, focused on false-positive reduction, clean evaluation, and collaborative Git workflows.
summary_facts: AI/ML engineer (M.Sc. Computer Science, Machine Intelligence, 2026) with about 6 months of professional experience across research and industry internships.
At Quantumweave Intelligence, develops computer-vision pipelines (YOLO, RT-DETR, ByteTrack) for drone and surveillance video with GPU inference optimization and false-positive reduction.
Built an offline Malayalam-English RAG chatbot using Llama-3 and Ollama, plus an agentic storefront platform producing Pydantic-validated structured outputs.
Engineered an automated PDF/DOCX medical report extraction pipeline and contributed FastAPI backend modules to a clinical PI-RADS reporting platform at Synbrains Solutions.
Designed FedGraph-Shield, a hierarchical federated graph neural network framework with differential privacy for fraud detection across banking networks.
Strong technical foundation in Python, PyTorch, FastAPI, Django, Docker, and REST APIs with rigorous evaluation and clean documentation.

bullets.text: Build and optimise computer-vision pipelines for UAV and surveillance video: object detection (YOLO, RT-DETR, RF-DETR), multi-object tracking (ByteTrack/BoT-SORT), and crowd counting (CSRNet), with GPU inference and configurable presets.
Developed telemetry-aware drone intrusion detection that combines flight telemetry, camera projection, and geofencing with a temporal state machine, and exports structured analytics.
Cut false positives and flicker with physical-size filters, calibrated thresholds, and track smoothing; added automated unit tests.
Built explainable anomaly and suspicious-object detection for aerial video, plus maritime vessel detection and tracking, using rule-based reasoning on top of detector outputs.
Built Docker-deployed web dashboards for multi-feed drone surveillance and incident reporting; benchmarked models and documented results for the team.

Built an automated report-extraction pipeline from specification documents with no prior codebase, using Pydantic data contracts and regex-based parsing to convert raw PDF/DOCX medical reports into validated ReportDraft schemas.
Contributed to a clinical AI reporting platform (PI-RADS) with FastAPI backend integration, scoring, image-handling, and sector-mapping modules.
Worked in Git branching workflows for collaborative feature development across the team.

projects.name: AI-Powered E-Commerce Storefront & Catalog Generation Agent
projects.description: Agentic platform converting natural-language prompts and product images into full e-commerce storefronts and structured catalogs.

bullets.text: Built an agentic platform that converts natural-language prompts into complete e-commerce storefronts, autonomously generating branding, category hierarchy, landing pages, and website content.
Built a multimodal pipeline using VLMs and LLMs to extract product information from images and generate structured catalogs with titles, descriptions, specifications, categories, and SEO metadata.

projects.name: KuTo: Kerala-First Managed Booking Marketplace
projects.description: Managed travel booking marketplace for Kerala experiences, stays, and transport.

bullets.text: Built a managed booking marketplace for Kerala covering guides, stays, transport, and experiences; customers can book one service or ask an organiser to arrange a visit.
Modelled every booking with a responsible provider, accepted terms, payment records, and a support route; combined visits have a lead organiser and separately recorded components.

projects.name: Manglish WhatsApp Chatbot (RAG with Llama-3 / Ollama)
projects.description: Offline regional-language assistant grounding local Llama-3 inference via RAG.

bullets.text: Built an offline Malayalam-English chatbot using retrieval-augmented generation (RAG): similarity-based retrieval of relevant knowledge and responses grounds local Llama-3 inference, so answers stay relevant without any cloud API.
Combined rule-based intent analysis with retrieval and LLM generation in a hybrid design for real-time regional-language messaging.

projects.name: FedGraph-Shield: Hierarchical Federated Graph Learning for Financial Fraud Detection
projects.description: Privacy-preserving fraud detection framework across distributed banking networks.

bullets.text: Designed a hierarchical federated graph learning framework allowing distributed banking institutions to collaboratively train a fraud detection model without sharing raw transaction data.

Modelled financial transactions as directed heterogeneous graphs (customers, merchants, and devices as nodes; payments as edges), enabling detection of ring structures and circular payment chains invisible to tabular approaches.

Coordinated federated aggregation via the Flower framework using a two-tier hierarchical FedAvg strategy with differential privacy composition for formal privacy accounting across communication rounds.

projects.name: Adaptive Confidence Modeling for SHADER-Based 3D Human Body Shape Estimation
projects.description: Dynamic confidence modeling framework improving 3D human shape reconstruction accuracy.

bullets.text: Introduced a dynamic, image-driven confidence model replacing the original global-sigma formulation in the SHADER monocular 3D shape estimation pipeline for loose-clothing scenarios.
Achieved 20–25% lower confidence-prediction error on 9,656 dressed-human images, producing more stable SMPL estimation without additional data or architectural changes.

projects.name: Dynamic Connectome Prediction of Reality Monitoring Failure Under Sleep Deprivation
projects.description: Neuroimaging connectome framework predicting cognitive monitoring failure from resting-state fMRI.

bullets.text: Designing a dynamic connectome framework using resting-state fMRI to predict reality monitoring failure before overt behavioural symptoms appear with applications to psychosis-risk and fatigue research.

Employing Graph Attention Networks (GATs) to identify informative prefrontal sensory connections associated with sleep-deprivation-induced network instability (currently at the preprocessing and parcellation stage).

projects.name: PETZZO: Comprehensive Pet Care Platform
projects.description: Full-stack pet healthcare and service marketplace platform.

bullets.text: Built a full-stack platform connecting pet owners with verified hospitals, veterinarians, and pet shops, featuring AI-driven disease prediction, real-time pet tracking, and appointment booking.
Implemented pet health record and vaccination management, pet adoption workflows, and streamlined pet shop operations within a single integrated system.
